Apple Event September 2019: iPhone 11 Pro display slide

An early Apple summary slide that already uses a grid of tiles in mixed sizes, but with square corners.

Source
Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple Event September 2019
Creator
Apple Inc.
Made
2019-09-10 (Apple Event “By innovation only”)
Style
Bento grid (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Dramatic, technical
Evidence
Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP [Apple Event September 2019]-[iPhone]-[iPhone 11 Pro (1)].webp from the fan archive Apple Summary Slides (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple introduced iPhone 11 Pro at its event on 10 September 2019. The fan archive starts its collection of summary slides with this event.

Observed

  • The frame is a photo of the stage: a presenter stands in front of a large screen that shows the slide, so the slide is seen in perspective and partly covered.
  • Dark tiles of several sizes fill the screen with narrow, even dark gutters. Their corners are square or only very slightly rounded.
  • Tiles hold large white figures with small labels (“1200 nits peak brightness”, “458 pixels per inch”, “15%”), large words (“OLED”, “HDR”), and pictures of the phone and of abstract texture.
  • “Wide color” is filled with a rainbow gradient. “Haptic Touch” sits in a tile of orange and pink concentric rings.

Why it belongs

The content rules of the bento grid are present here, one year before Apple rounded the tiles. Compare the rounded tiles of WWDC 2020. The square tiles connect the form to the tile grids of Metro.

Borrow

Mix figure tiles with picture tiles so that the eye moves between numbers and images.
